hero.heading: Anime Crusaders X: Verified Game Guide and Player Hub

sections.heading: Summoning Costs and Starting Resource Bonuses
sections.intro: When you start Anime Crusaders X, the official game listing advertises bonus gems and rerolls for two actions: joining the developer's group and liking the game. According to the official Roblox description, completing both earns you 1,000+ starting gems plus additional rerolls to help you summon your first units. These bonuses are designed to give new players an immediate resource boost without requiring in-game grinding before your first pulls.
paragraphs: The exact current value of these bonuses and whether any conditional requirements (account age, server region) apply have not been independently tested by player reports in available sources. If you claim the bonuses and the advertised amount does not appear, check that you have joined the official group and liked the game page on Roblox. If the gems still do not arrive, visit the game's communications server (linked on the main game page) to report the issue; the developers post code updates and support information there regularly.

Because summoning is central to unit collection in tower defense, these starting resources directly affect your early-game team diversity. Plan your first summons carefully: rerolls let you reset and try again if you are unhappy with your initial pull, so you can aim for units that match your preferred playstyle before committing gems to leveling.

sections.heading: Getting Started: Core Systems and Progression
sections.intro: Anime Crusaders X is built around a tower-defense loop: you place anime units along a path and they automatically attack enemy waves that advance toward your base. Your job between waves is to manage placement, upgrades, and squad composition rather than direct combat.
paragraphs: Units are your primary resource. You collect them through summoning, and each unit has its own stats and role. Leveling a unit up is how you unlock its abilities, so investing experience into a single character meaningfully changes what it can do in battle rather than just increasing a flat damage number.

Squad building sits on top of that progression. The game lets you assemble a team from your collected roster, which means early decisions about which units to level affect how quickly you can clear harder waves. The tier list page covers which units are worth that investment, and the units database lists individual abilities and acquisition methods for each character.
